> This is a demo website built by NorthWeb.co for the Creative / Freelance industry.

## What this site is
Portfolio Website is a professionally designed demo website showcasing how a creative / freelance business can look online. It was built by NorthWeb.co (yourdomain.com) as part of their client portfolio of web design services.

## Tagline
Let your work do the talking

## Description
A stunning personal portfolio that showcases your best work and attracts high-value clients.

## Industry
Creative / Freelance

## Key Features
- Portfolio Grid: Curated showcase of your best work with case study breakdowns.
- Case Studies: In-depth project walkthroughs showing your process and results.
- Skills Section: Visual skill display and technology stacks that demonstrate expertise.
- Smart Contact: Professional enquiry form that qualifies serious clients.
- Social Links: Showcase Behance, Dribbble, GitHub, or LinkedIn profiles.
- Testimonials: Real client quotes that validate your quality and reliability.
